note: First Linux measurement of the lane's pinned css-fonts/css-writing-modes pixel selections. WPT was unavailable on the Boat sandbox through TEXT-14/15/16 (filed in .agents/text/questions.md); scripts/ensure-wpt.sh now provisions the pinned revision there. Renderer/comparator: crates/amazing-text-provider/evidence/text18-render-wpt.py, a Python port of scripts/run-render-wpt.ps1's comparison (exact PPM diff, <meta name=fuzzy> tolerance, mismatch-relation inversion), run via `amazing render-wpt <page> <out.ppm> 800 600` with AMAZING_WPT_ROOT set to the checkout. Each selection run twice back to back with identical counts and per-test actual/reference/diff SHA-256 (stable).

fonts-15.notes: Matches the last Windows measurement exactly. The one mismatch is font-unicode-PUA-primary-font, the environment-owned Arial/Times PUA-glyph case (TEXT-6/TEXT-13); on Linux the installed-fallback face differs (DejaVu, see TEXT-17) but the case still mismatches for the same PUA-coverage reason.

font-face-8.compare_to: TEXT-12/13 win-001: 4 pass / 4 mismatch (retained, unchanged both tickets)
font-face-8.notes: Same 4/8 split as the last two Windows measurements. The four matching__* mismatches (fixed-stretch-style-over-weight, range-descriptor-reversed, stretch-distance-over-weight-distance, style-ranges-over-weight-direction) are the pre-existing @font-face descriptor-matching gap noted since TEXT-2/TEXT-12; the four variations__* cases pass.

vertical-7.notes: Same split as TEXT-12's Windows measurement. writing-mode-vertical-lr-002 and direction-upright-001 remain layout-owned per the TEXT-7..13 routing.

expanded-40.compare_to: TEXT-13 win-001: 38 pass / 2 mismatch (font-kerning-02, font-size-adjust-zero-2 area)
expanded-40.notes: All 40 pass on current dev (bbd741b6, past TEXT-14's kerning axis fix and TEXT-15/16). No regression from the TEXT-13 baseline; the two prior mismatches are gone, consistent with TEXT-14's font-kerning-02/03 fix landing afterward. This is the first Linux run of this selection.

relationship_to_text17: Before TEXT-17's fix, register_system_text_faces registered zero faces for any family on Linux (Windows-only hardcoded paths), so this entire corpus would have rendered as full-coverage boxes rather than exercising real shaping/rasterization/fallback paths. These are the first Linux numbers for this corpus and were only meaningful once TEXT-17 landed.
